scope: Garrison exhausted post reuse after casualties
finding: Final route failures marked the actor failed but left the interior post in group candidates. The living failed assignment reserved it, but a later death removed that reservation, allowing a replacement to spend another approach budget on the same exhausted post.
implementation: Final deadline/retry exhaustion collects exact position/bearing/building/transform candidate keys. Same-callback alternatives exclude those keys immediately. One owner/current-generation/nonempty-order/external-owner guarded metadata commit removes them from the existing <=512 candidate pool. Refill and later reassignments read that public pool; owner migration retains it. Fresh explicit order rebuilds its pool. No permanent model blacklist or new journal/worker/deadline/native command.
cost: One temporary bounded hash set and at most one512-row metadata filter on callbacks with new final interior failures. No new geometry/world query or per-actor public pool rewriting.

validation.fullPipeline: Passed: 1476 existing tests and complete build gates; .qa/cbe-garrison-exhausted-post-build.log

limits: Route exhaustion is episode-local unavailable status, not proof a building position is universally inaccessible. Existing held posts and living/unconscious reservations are unchanged. This does not complete garrison relief/CQB flow.
